Highly Recommend Benz Eatery
Mar 2026 • Family
We had such a great experience at Benz Eatery and ended up coming back multiple times during our stay. Every single meal was cooked to perfection — always fresh, full of flavour, and beautifully presented.

We tried a wide range of dishes, including fish & chips, chicken and chips, burgers, fried seafood noodles, Tom yum with seafood, and creamy chicken and mushroom pasta — and honestly, everything was consistently delicious. It’s rare to find a place that does so many different dishes this well.

The portions are generous and the prices are very fair for the quality you receive. Even when the restaurant was busy (which it often was), the food always came out perfect.

The staff really make the experience even better — they are incredibly friendly, welcoming, and always happy to help.

Highly recommend Benz Eatery if you’re in Phu Quoc — it’s one of those places you’ll want to come back to again and again.
